messages:
Marta: Quick sync — planning to flip the precision gate for rw-7b tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Goal: enable int8 profiles (with fp16 fallback) for a 5% canary. Need quick checks and owners.
Kevin: What’s the canary audience exactly? routing details? fallback behavior?
Marta: Canary = 5% of web + API traffic, explicitly exclude enterprise/dedicated accounts. Routing -> prefer gpu-intel pool; fallback to fp16 if we observe perf regress > 5% or error rate spike.
Priya: Safety metrics to watch: p95 latency, error rate, hallucination rate on the smoke eval set, and token-cost delta. Can we get dashboard links?
Marta: Dashboard (quick): https://console.redwood/dashboards/quant-safety — I’ll post a short smoke script below for the eval set.
Marta: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/run -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -d '{"model":"rw-7b","precision":"int8","input":"<smoke_prompt_batch>"}'
```
Ana: Ran 250 samples on int8 this morning against the curated smoke prompts. No hallucination spikes; token diffs are minor. CSV uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/smoke-int8-1998.csv
Kevin: PR incoming for the rollout-service flag glue: added `precision_gate` + metadata (audience, start, escape_hatch). Will tag for review.
TJ: I can review the PR and kick off the e2e perf runs. Ping me when it’s up.
ops-bot: Scheduled window 1998-12-12 09:00-10:30 UTC. Autoscale policy: +20% burst. Canary config pushed to staging namespace.
deploy-bot: Canary config deployed to staging: tag=quant-canary-1998. Acceptance checks running (smoke, perf, regression).
Marta: :thumbsup: Escape hatch is `precision.quant_toggle=off` or force `profile=fp16` via admin. Documented in runbook (see #eng-ops). If any alert fires, we flip immediately.
Priya: One addition — please add an alert on response entropy change: >0.15 absolute vs baseline. That catches subtle quality drops.
Kevin: Will add entropy metric and alert thresholds in the PR. Also wiring in a quick rollback script.
Marta: Thanks — sounds good. If deploy and acceptance checks are green, we flip 5% tomorrow. Will post final checklist after PR + perf runs. /cc Ana, TJ
